Zoe (CS): putting together a very short streaming-first kickoff note for customers who rely on partial responses (live chat, doc assist). want: preflight checklist, streaming best-practices, and a clear rollback if streaming causes latency spikes. feedback welcome.

Vik (Eng): +1. Key engineering tips: prefer smaller batch_size (2-4) when streaming to reduce tail latency; enable token-flush at 150ms for responsive UX; use prefix-prefill for repeated conversation starters to populate KV early.

Priyanka (SRE): ops guardrails to add: alert if streamed response tail latency (time between first token and final token) > 1.5s p95 OR backend 5xx > 2% for 3m -> pause streaming mode and fall back to non-streaming full-response path. Add an observability query to watch streaming tail: `quantile_over_time(0.95, request_duration_seconds{streaming="true"}[5m])`.

Zoe (CS): customer-facing 1-liner to paste in kickoff: "We'll run a short streaming warmup using representative prompts to warm caches and calibrate token flushing. We'll send a 24h snapshot and do a 72h check-in. If streaming degrades latency we'll temporarily switch to non-streamed responses and notify you."

Noel (PM): add renewal-risk capture: "streaming success rate" (percent of sessions where first-token latency < 200ms), 24h cache-hit%, p95 tail latency, and a 72h customer sentiment note. Include in the kickoff report.

Vik (Eng): tiny streaming warmup command (safe):
`for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-3b\",\"input\":\"hello\",\"stream\":true,\"max_tokens\":32}'; sleep 0.2; done`

Priyanka (SRE): preflight checklist for streaming customers:
- confirm websocket/proxy idle timeouts >= 120s
- pin model version and streaming flag during warmup
- validate logs include token-level timing
- smoke test 5 streamed sessions and confirm first-token p50 < 200ms

Zoe (CS): cost transparency blurb: streaming can increase token counts slightly (prefixes + partial outputs)  we'll estimate warmup token usage in kickoff email and offer Dedicated warm_pool to smooth billing spikes.

Priyanka (SRE): rollback playbook (concise):
1) Detect degradation (alerts above).
2) Flip tenant to non-streaming full-response endpoint.
3) Reduce batch_size and limit concurrency.
4) If errors persist, route traffic to compact fallback model and open #release-war-room.

cs-bot: reminder set  follow-up to @Zoe (CS) in 72 hours to collect the 72h streaming feedback tick. :white_check_mark:

Zoe (CS): thanks team, i'll add this to the enablement repo under the streaming kickoff template and include the small script in the kickoff email. Tag me for wording tweaks. :pray:
